title: What Self-Healing Software Codebases Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Self-healing software codebases are code repositories that detect, diagnose, and repair their own bugs: failing tests trigger AI agents that localize the fault, generate patches, verify them against the test suite, and open reviewed pull requests — with humans approving before merge. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Self-Healing Software Codebases: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Self-Healing Software Codebases in one line: Self-healing software codebases are code repositories that detect, diagnose, and repair their own bugs: failing tests trigger AI agents that localize the fault, generate patches, verify them against the test suite, and open reviewed pull requests — with humans approving before merge.
Why it matters: Software maintenance consumes most engineering budgets; self-healing codebases turn bug fixing from toil into supervision..
Where it is used: large enterprise codebases, open-source maintenance, legacy modernization, continuous deployment pipelines..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Challenges and Open Problems in Self-Healing Software Codebases
title: Challenges and Open Problems in Self-Healing Software Codebases
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: The core challenge is trust: a wrong patch is worse than no patch. Agents need perfect test oracles, must not leak secrets or break security invariants, and must know when to escalate instead of guessing. Every challenge here is a design requirement in disguise: solve it and the technology moves forward. The pieces records each carry the challenge they exist to answer.
